thesis: Single-strategy shorts catch early downside before consensus forms. Multi-agree entries come late into the move and pay for the crowding.
evidence: A: n=110, +$6.85/trade, +$753 vs negative rest. C: n=722, -4.4bps vs about -16bps for all other signals. Caveat: trades are concentrated in trending_bear (+$749, n=14).

thesis: BTC shorts lose the least of any liquid slice. Downside moves follow through more cleanly than other majors, with less squeeze noise.
evidence: A: n=37, +$6.65/trade, +$246. C: n=460, -5.0bps vs about -15.6bps for the rest. Trades and signals agree. ETH/SOL shorts are positive in A but not in C, so no rule there.

thesis: Lone-strategy longs mostly buy into the chop/consolidation regimes where long entries lose. With no confirmation, the 4h drift plus fees overwhelms them.
evidence: A: n=57, 23% win, -$11.38/trade, -$649 (worst trade slice). C: n=552, -16.2bps vs about -14.3bps for the rest. Weaker in C but same direction. B: little recent long volume.
